Get ready for a spooky Bollywood night full of music, dancing, and Halloween vibes—in person!

About this Event

🎃 BOLLYWEEN 2.0 👻
Where Bollywood Meets Halloween!
Get ready for a Halloween night with a Desi twist! 🔥
EVENT SAAN, in collaboration with Boozemandu, brings you BOLLYWEEN 2.0 — a one-of-a-kind celebration mixing Bollywood energy, Halloween madness, and unforgettable party vibes!
🎧 DJ SARIF will be taking over the decks, spinning Bollywood bangers, Afro House, and electrifying party anthems to keep the dance floor alive all night!
Whether you’re rocking a spooky costume, a stunning saree, or your own creative Halloween look, come dressed to impress and ready to dance!
📅 Saturday, October 31, 2026
🕘 Doors Open: 9:00 PM
📍 Venue: Boozemandu | Pickerington, Ohio
🎶 Music: Bollywood • Afro House • Open Format
🍸 21+ to Drink
One Night. Two Worlds. Endless Vibes.
This isn’t just another Halloween party. It’s BOLLYWEEN 2.0!
Grab your crew, plan your outfits, and get ready for a Halloween night with a Bollywood twist! 🎃🔥
